# Pub pool table and its lamp, phase 2: materials (exact Chromatic16 sRGB), the shade's sloped
# sides, the rails' inner faces as cushions, hidden faces deleted, the table and the lamp joined
# into two objects, export. Run after p1_blockout.txt. Generated by make_table.py.
material new Felt --base-color 0.1255 0.6745 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Cushion --base-color 0.1255 0.6745 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Rail --base-color 0.6275 0.3137 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Apron --base-color 0.5020 0.0000 0.0941 --no-slot
material new Leg --base-color 0.6275 0.3137 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Pocket --base-color 0.0000 0.0000 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Shade --base-color 0.1255 0.6745 0.0000 --no-slot
material new ShadeTop --base-color 0.1255 0.6745 0.0000 --no-slot
material new Glow --base-color 1.0000 0.7529 0.5020 --no-slot
material new Cord --base-color 0.0000 0.0000 0.0000 --no-slot
select Felt
material assign Felt

select Felt
active Felt
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select RailF RailB RailL RailR
material assign Rail

select RailF
active RailF
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.y > 0.9"
material assign Cushion
mode object

select RailB
active RailB
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.y < -0.9"
material assign Cushion
mode object

select RailL
active RailL
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.x > 0.9"
material assign Cushion
mode object

select RailR
active RailR
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.x < -0.9"
material assign Cushion
mode object

select Apron
material assign Apron

select Apron
active Apron
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3
material assign Leg

select Leg0
active Leg0
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg1
active Leg1
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg2
active Leg2
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Leg3
active Leg3
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Pocket0 Pocket1 Pocket2 Pocket3 Pocket4 Pocket5
material assign Pocket

select Pocket0
active Pocket0
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Pocket1
active Pocket1
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Pocket2
active Pocket2
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Pocket3
active Pocket3
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Pocket4
active Pocket4
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Pocket5
active Pocket5
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Shade
material assign Shade

select Shade
active Shade
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
scale 0.8722 0.6818 1
material assign ShadeTop
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Glow
material assign Glow

select Glow
active Glow
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CordL CordR
material assign Cord

select CordL
active CordL
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select CordR
active CordR
mode edit
select face where "abs(normal.z) > 0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object

select Felt RailF RailB RailL RailR Apron Leg0 Leg1 Leg2 Leg3 Pocket0 Pocket1 Pocket2 Pocket3 Pocket4 Pocket5
active Apron
join
rename Apron Table

select Shade Glow CordL CordR
active Shade
join
rename Shade Lamp

select all
shade flat
export table.glb

select Table
export table_body.glb --selection

select Lamp
cursor set 0 0 1.94
origin set --to cursor
set location 0 0 0
export lamp.glb --selection
set location 0 0 1.94
